hints.title: Windows overlap
hints.body: Neighboring windows share most of their elements. Can you keep the useful candidates from the previous window instead of scanning every value again?

hints.title: A deque of candidates
hints.body: Keep indices in a deque whose values decrease from front to back. The front is always the maximum of the current window.

hints.title: Maintain the decreasing order
hints.body: Before adding a new index, remove indices from the back while their values are no larger than the new value; they can never be the maximum again. Then remove the front index if it has fallen out of the window.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body: For each index i: pop back while the deque is non-empty and nums[back] <= nums[i]; push i. If the front index is <= i - k, pop it. Once i >= k - 1, append nums[front].
